definition: what is rubbing in how we handle money, and what I am asking to change

settled:
Friction says a review is due. It is not an interval elapsing, and neither of us has misunderstood the other.

What has changed since we last settled it: I have stopped working, we are living on a runway that sustains nothing itself, and we understand our own neurodiversity now.

Three things are rubbing. The categorising is manual, Jen has owned it alone, and she is nine months behind. Large capital expenses fit the approach badly, like a roof or water heaters or solar panels. And it does not match what I want on the time dimension.

Four things I take into the talk. Consider her interests, and say out loud that I have. Put the education reason ahead of the business one. Ask for a lump sum rather than a monthly rate, for capacity spending and for capital both. Ask whether I can build more AI around the categorising.

title: Why Our Money Arrangement Is Up For Review
